name: 23817-visionchat-a3b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 -- four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, one vLLM engine.
architecture: KimiVLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 16.4B total with ~3B active per token; the checkpoint's own config.json is the authority on its shape.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text + synthetic_image, single turn, exactly ONE image per request: 111 prompt tokens (min = max), 128 output tokens (min = max), one 768x768 JPEG at quality 85 with noise content, seed 42, temperature 0.0. Every request carries different image bytes.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant replying briefly to one photo per request for 32 concurrent users across four GPUs.
launch:
model: moonshotai/Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506
tensor-parallel-size: 4
trust-remote-code: true
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 128

# HAZARD -- do not drop this line. A modality left unset resolves to 999 per prompt
# (config/__init__.py get_limit_per_prompt), so the startup profiler sizes a vision batch for
# traffic this workload never sends and every TP rank dies with `torch.OutOfMemoryError` once the
# weights are resident. One image and no video is this scenario's true shape.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1, "video": 0}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.93
# Off. Written negated, as the command-line flag `--no-enable-prefix-caching`: a false value
# reaches the command line as no flag at all, and this engine then turns prefix caching on.
no-enable-prefix-caching: true
